name: Cruise control in the minimap HUD stack
setup: Use a disposable REBIRTH world with an active cooking job, minimap visible, and a vehicle in an open area. Sit in the driver seat. Use the physical Q key with default bindings and capture the HUD at each step with Game Bridge screenshot and uitree.
cases: With cruise off, record the resting positions of the minimap, cooking card, and any ammo or pickup displays.
Press Q once. Cruise Control: Normal appears immediately above the minimap, which stays in place. The other right-side displays move up by one row.
Press Q again. Cruise Control: Turbo replaces Normal in the same row. Other displays stay at the same height.
Press Q again. The cruise row disappears and the other displays return to their original positions.
Engage cruise and leave the driver seat. The cruise row disappears and the HUD collapses. Confirm no cruise display when pressing Q as a passenger.
Repeat with no cooking jobs and with the minimap hidden. The cruise row remains available to the driver.
